title: Paper Route · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Route · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws three dots and a start point on a sheet. The lead draws one continuous line from the start through all three dots. The line reaches all three dots without lifting the pencil. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Route, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The line reaches all three dots without lifting the pencil.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The line reaches all three dots without lifting the pencil.
